user_instruction: accept all 3 terms. note down the restricions for each dataset to be used downstream.
publisher_submission_status: No account registration, click-through submission or data query was performed to record this decision.
scope: HUD USPS crosswalk API terms, CDC WONDER data-use restrictions, and AHRQ CLH DUA including the embedded AHRF license reviewed on this date.
supersedes: Only the pending user terms-acceptance decisions for HUD, WONDER and S26_CLH in older access ledgers; immutable source records and their hashes remain unchanged.
enforcement_status: documented_policy; not yet integrated into collector or publication validators
downstream_requirements: Carry source ID, release, original source lineage and this restriction record through raw storage, transformations, joins, features, training, evaluation, reports, APIs and exported artifacts.
Terms acceptance does not clear credential, route, privacy, coverage, geography, definition, quality, leakage or model-eligibility holds.
For mixed-source outputs retain every applicable source restriction; transformations do not remove obligations.
Review intended recipients and content before sharing data, trained artifacts, dashboards, named-hospital outputs or public repository files; do not assume a derived artifact is unrestricted.
If publisher terms change, review the new version before further use; this record is not advance acceptance of unknown terms.

restrictions: API access/use constitutes acceptance; comply with the linked HUD privacy policy and applicable law and third-party intellectual-property rights.
Display prominently in applications using the API: This product uses the HUD User Data API but is not endorsed or certified by HUD User.
Do not imply HUD endorsement or certification; do not modify or falsely represent API content while claiming it is HUD content. Clearly distinguish project-derived results from publisher originals.
Maximum 60 API queries per minute; do not circumvent access or usage limits.
Terms include indemnification, warranty and liability limitations; HUD may limit or terminate access and revise terms.
operational_requirements: Register an account and the USPS dataset, confirm the account, and create a bearer token; store the token in the approved secret store, never logs or chat.
Use explicit year, quarter and crosswalk direction; preserve string geography identifiers and address-ratio meanings.
Nationwide All/state API queries are documented from 2021 Q1; verify a permitted route for earlier required releases.

restrictions: Use only for statistical reporting and analysis.

Do not attempt identification of persons or establishments, including through linkage; do not disclose or otherwise use inadvertently discovered identities. Report inadvertent identification to the officials named in the applicable CDC/NCHS policy.
Do not present or publish statistics representing nine or fewer births or deaths, including rates based on those counts, in any medium.
Preserve database-specific suppression constraints, caveats and footnotes when reassembling data; do not reconstruct suppressed cells.
All subsequent reuse remains subject to the data-use restrictions.
operational_requirements: The reviewed restrictions may be acknowledged in the permitted request interface under this acceptance; capture the applicable database/version and agreement evidence during acquisition.
The documented NVSS mortality API permits national data only; it is not an authorized substitute for a county export.
Prepare an exact county-by-year export scope using a permitted route; preserve age-adjustment methods, population denominators, suppression and unreliable-rate flags.

datasets.terms_location: Printed pages xvii-xix: CLH Data Use Agreement and AHRF Data Use License Agreement
restrictions: Use signifies agreement. Use/disclosure is limited to research, analysis and aggregate statistical reporting as permitted by the DUA.
Do not release information directly or indirectly identifying persons, including identification through vulnerability analysis or penetration testing.
Do not publish or report data that identify individual establishments directly or by inference; do not attempt to discover establishment identities absent from the data.
Acknowledge AHRQ Community-Level Health (CLH) Database in reports. Interpretations are the analyst's and not US Government, HHS or AHRQ findings, policies or recommendations.
The user is personally responsible for compliance. Report violations or apparent violations to AHRQ without unreasonable delay and within 30 calendar days of awareness.
The DUA includes indemnification/defense/hold-harmless provisions to the extent permitted by federal and state law.

Embedded AHRF terms prohibit distributing copies or making the data available to third parties, subject to limited minimal-amount scholarly, educational, scientific or professional-use exceptions; no sale. Credited figures, tables and brief excerpts are permitted within the stated conditions.

AHRF reproduction/redistribution remains subject to copyright-owner consent; use the AHRF citation in the documentation. Retain the embedded license and any underlying-source restrictions with affected variables.
operational_requirements: Retain version-specific codebooks, source provenance and variable-specific availability and measurement periods; do not combine prior SDOH versions with updated CLH as if consistent.

Before hospital-identifiable publication or third-party access, establish compatibility with establishment-reporting and embedded redistribution restrictions. Acceptance alone does not resolve that compatibility.
Private storage is not a blanket permission for sharing: evaluate actual users, service access and outputs against the agreement. No claim of explicit cloud-storage permission is made here.
